messages:
marta: Quick heads-up — aiming to cut v0.23.0 tomorrow 15:00 UTC. Need final sign-offs for: version bump, changelog, docs, QA gates, and security scan. planning to freeze merges 13:00 UTC. Please ack with your areas. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
liam: Ack for merge freeze at 13:00. I'll hold any non-critical merges and monitor CI. If you need an urgent patch after freeze, ping me here and I'll coordinate a hotfix branch. :ok_hand:
kevin: I can own the version bump and release note assembly. Will run the bump script and push the tag after all sign-offs. Command I'll run:```./scripts/bump_version.sh 0.23.0 && git push --tags```
sophia: Docs check: I'll go through the guide pages and quickstart this evening. If anything needs a screenshot refresh or callout, I'll drop a PR by EOD. :mag:
qa_jordan: QA report: nightly e2e showed 2 flaky tests in the streaming path (chat_stream.test). I'll rerun a focused suite tonight and post results. If failures persist, we should delay the cut by 1h to investigate.
security-bot: Automated scan complete — no high sev findings. One medium: `deps: graphql@15.5.0` flagged; recommended upgrade to 15.6.x. More details in the security dashboard.
kevin: Noted re deps. I can include a small deps PR as long as it doesn't change public API. If it does, we should defer.
liam: Can we do a quick rollback plan in case the canary shows regressions? My plan: tag rollback to previous stable tag and route traffic back in 5 mins. Anyone opposed?
marta: Sounds good. Please draft the rollback runbook and drop it here before freeze. Liam, can you stub it? :clipboard:
liam: Stubbed runbook in PR: `infra/release/runbooks/railgun-rollback.md` — will flesh out steps and contacts.
qa_jordan: Rerun done — streaming test passed on 5/5. Uploading results in /tests/reports/v0.23.0. All major e2e green.
sophia: Docs PR open: #482 — includes quickstart updates and changelog entries for the new batching knobs. Please review.
kevin: Drafted changelog in `changelogs/0.23.0.md`. Needs copyedit + SME confirm on the KV cache note. cc @sophia @marta
security-bot: Quick reminder: for Private deployments we need the new KMS key rotation note in the compliance docs. Marking as low priority for this cut but must be merged before next private patch.
marta: Okay — updated checklist: version bump (kevin), changelog (kevin), docs (sophia), QA signoff (qa_jordan), security review (security-bot), runbook (liam). If all green by 12:30 UTC tomorrow I'll give final go.
kevin: One ask — can someone approve the dependency bump once I open the PR? I won't merge it without an approval from eng-ml (quick sanity check).
liam: I'll review the deps PR first thing tomorrow.
marta: Great. If anyone hits blockers overnight, drop a short note here. Otherwise I'll post the final green at 12:35 UTC and start the push at 15:00 UTC. :rocket:
deploy-bot: Canary job scheduled for 2024-06-15T15:05:00Z. Watch logs: https://ci.internal/release/1845126789/canary
kevin: Tagged locally, holding until final ack.
qa_jordan: Final ack — all tests passed and smoke checks are clean.
marta: FINAL: go for cut at 15:00 UTC. Thanks all! :tada:
